monitor_supervisor_shell: deadline_epoch=$(/bin/date -j -u -f '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' '2026-08-25T21:56:19Z' '+%s'); index=0; api_failures=0; dashboard_failures=0; queue_pressure_samples=0; stop_reason=

while [ "$(/bin/date -u '+%s')" -lt "$deadline_epoch" ]; do index=$((index + 1)); cycle_start=$(/bin/date -u '+%s'); observed_at=$(/bin/date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'); snapshot="$observation_dir/snapshot-$(printf '%04d' "$index").json"; http_code=$(/usr/bin/curl -sS --max-time 3 -o "$snapshot" -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/v2/snapshot 2>/dev/null || true); dashboard_code=$(/usr/bin/curl -sS --max-time 3 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:4173/ 2>/dev/null || true); scanner_pid=$(/usr/bin/pgrep -f '/var/run-private-scanner/bin/scanner --trading-date 2026-08-25' | /usr/bin/head -1 || true); rss_kb=0; cpu_percent=0; if [ -n "$scanner_pid" ]; then rss_kb=$(/bin/ps -p "$scanner_pid" -o rss= | /usr/bin/awk '{print $1+0}'); cpu_percent=$(/bin/ps -p "$scanner_pid" -o %cpu= | /usr/bin/awk '{print $1+0}'); fi

if [ "$http_code" != 200 ] || ! /usr/bin/jq -e . "$snapshot" >/dev/null 2>&1; then api_failures=$((api_failures + 1)); else api_failures=0; accounting=$(/usr/bin/jq -r '.status.accounting_valid and .operations.sample_accounting_valid' "$snapshot"); tq_integrity=$(/usr/bin/jq -r '.tq.facts.integrity|tonumber' "$snapshot"); recovery_bad=$(/usr/bin/jq -r '[(.recovery.work.failed|tonumber),(.recovery.work.canceled|tonumber),(.recovery.work.fenced|tonumber)]|add' "$snapshot"); lifecycle=$(/usr/bin/jq -r '.publication.lifecycle' "$snapshot"); q_current=$(/usr/bin/jq -r '.operations.queue_current_frames' "$snapshot"); q_capacity=$(/usr/bin/jq -r '.operations.queue_capacity_frames' "$snapshot"); heap=$(/usr/bin/jq -r '.operations.heap_in_use_bytes|tonumber' "$snapshot"); if [ "$accounting" != true ] || [ "$tq_integrity" -ne 0 ] || [ "$recovery_bad" -ne 0 ] || [ "$lifecycle" = suppressed ]; then stop_reason=integrity_or_terminal; fi; if [ "$q_capacity" -gt 0 ] && [ $((q_current * 4)) -ge $((q_capacity * 3)) ]; then queue_pressure_samples=$((queue_pressure_samples + 1)); else queue_pressure_samples=0; fi; if [ "$queue_pressure_samples" -ge 3 ]; then stop_reason=sustained_queue_growth; fi; if [ "$heap" -gt 6442450944 ] || [ "$rss_kb" -gt 6291456 ]; then stop_reason=unsafe_host_impact; fi; fi

/usr/bin/jq -c --arg observed_at "$observed_at" --arg http "$http_code" --arg dashboard "$dashboard_code" --arg rss "$rss_kb" --arg cpu "$cpu_percent" '{observed_at:$observed_at,http_code:($http|tonumber),dashboard_code:($dashboard|tonumber),rss_kb:($rss|tonumber),cpu_percent:($cpu|tonumber),sample_id:.sample.id,publication_id:.publication.id,lifecycle:.publication.lifecycle,backend_ready:.status.backend_ready,readiness_reason:.status.readiness_reason,committed_t:.publication.committed_t,watermark_lag_ms:.status.watermark_lag_ms,ranking_mode:.ranking.mode,ranking_rows:(.rows|length),passers:.ranking.total_passers,hydration:.recovery.work,hydration_rows:.recovery.rows,queue_current:.operations.queue_current_frames,queue_high:.operations.queue_high_frames,queue_bytes:.operations.queue_current_bytes,queue_high_bytes:.operations.queue_high_bytes,mean_delay_ms:.operations.mean_processing_delay_ms,max_delay_ms:.operations.max_processing_delay_ms,heap_alloc_bytes:(.operations.heap_alloc_bytes|tonumber),heap_in_use_bytes:(.operations.heap_in_use_bytes|tonumber),goroutines:.operations.goroutines,accounting_valid:(.status.accounting_valid and .operations.sample_accounting_valid),tq_mode:.tq.pressure_mode,tq_cause:.tq.pressure_cause,tq_desired:(.tq.desired_symbols|length),tq_consumed:(.tq.facts.consumed|tonumber),tq_applied:(.tq.facts.applied|tonumber),tq_rejected:(.tq.facts.rejected|tonumber),tq_shed:(.tq.facts.pressure_shed|tonumber),tq_commands:.tq.commands}' "$snapshot" >> "$observation_dir/summary.ndjson"

if [ "$dashboard_code" != 200 ]; then dashboard_failures=$((dashboard_failures + 1)); else dashboard_failures=0; fi; if [ "$api_failures" -ge 3 ] || [ "$dashboard_failures" -ge 3 ]; then stop_reason=unusable_polling; fi; if [ -n "$stop_reason" ]; then /bin/kill -INT 5295 2>/dev/null || true; break; fi; cycle_end=$(/bin/date -u '+%s'); sleep_seconds=$((cycle_start + 1 - cycle_end)); if [ "$sleep_seconds" -gt 0 ]; then /bin/sleep "$sleep_seconds"; fi; done
executed_commands.resource_slope_command: jq -r '[.observed_at,.rss_kb,.heap_in_use_bytes,.queue_current,.cpu_percent]|@tsv' var/diagnostics/.lbr-e3-10m-20260825.u2Gboy/summary.ndjson | awk 'NR>31{x=NR-32; n++; sx+=x; sxx+=x*x; sy1+=$2; sxy1+=x*$2; sy2+=$3; sxy2+=x*$3; sy3+=$4; sxy3+=x*$4} END{d=n*sxx-sx*sx; printf "steady_samples=%d rss_kb_per_sec=%.3f heap_bytes_per_sec=%.3f queue_frames_per_sec=%.6f\n",n,(n*sxy1-sx*sy1)/d,(n*sxy2-sx*sy2)/d,(n*sxy3-sx*sy3)/d}'
